question: on all items, does storing the model-written derivation with binding beat running the same programs at query time, and where?

check.sha256: staged item tables equal their manifests

costs.unit: tokens per answered post-shift probe (reader prompt plus completion)

caveats: probes coincide with the maintenance checkpoints, so the stored cell's value is fresh at every probe: this compares a stored value with its program, not write-time with query-time freshness
the view requests the program for the definition version in force at the probe, a response-cache hit of block C's write-time requests: the programs are the same
the view serves an item whose program fails, or whose sources the agent may not read, as the zero system does

Stability of definition items rests on few item-times (see n_items), above all after S_def, and on few definition types (see per_definition_type): an item the stored cell cannot serve (its program fails at re-derivation) is still answered by the view's zero-system fallback
